title: Acc Rec Ceramics
seo_title: Acc Rec Ceramics Class in Springfield, MO – Nov 19
description: Acc Rec Ceramics is a class where you create ceramic projects, designed for people ages 16 and up with a disability. Classes are offered three times a week, so you can choose the one that fits your schedule. This session is on Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 9:00 AM at 305 E Talmage in Springfield, MO.
